controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by HD 73583; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of HD 73583 c is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the colour of hd-73583's light, as its colour lens measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of HD 73583's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 73583 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

HD 73583 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (34, 61, 88) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 101011575, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 15-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
